instruction: update the TodoList.spec with expect testing a real thing

arguments.content:
<?php

use App\TodoList;

describe(TodoList::class, function () {
    let('todoList', fn() => new TodoList());

    it('keeps track of added tasks', function () {
        $this->todoList->add('Buy milk');
        expect($this->todoList->tasks())->toBe(['Buy milk']);
    });
});
